title: Mandatory Incoterm Validation
description: For German standard sales orders require the Incoterm location. Returns and intercompany orders must be excluded from this validation.

title: High Value Purchase Order Approval
description: Purchase orders above EUR 50000 require an additional approval before they can be released. The workflow technology has not yet been selected.

title: Customer Credit Limit Validation
description: Before a sales order is released verify whether the customer has exceeded the approved credit limit. Orders exceeding the limit must require review.

title: Material Master Validation
description: Require product hierarchy and division for newly created finished goods. Existing materials must not be changed automatically.

title: European Pricing Performance Improvement
description: Improve pricing performance for European sales orders. The implementation approach and affected pricing components have not yet been identified.

title: Delivery Block for Export Orders
description: Apply a delivery block when export compliance information is missing from an international sales order. Domestic orders should remain unaffected.

title: Supplier Bank Detail Review
description: Changes to supplier bank information must require an additional review before being used for payment processing.

title: Warehouse Quantity Threshold
description: Create an additional review when a warehouse transfer quantity exceeds the configured threshold. The threshold and affected warehouses are not yet finalized.

title: Invoice Tolerance Validation
description: Invoices exceeding an agreed tolerance compared with the purchase order should require additional review before posting.

title: Sales Discount Governance
description: Sales orders containing discounts above an approved threshold should require additional approval. The threshold can differ by sales organization.
